scope: NTSRV selects authorized request and reservation stores under the original service lock. Reservation removal and connection rundown use the same service lock; the new scope replaces the previous stack binding, and each reservation mutation still uses its existing lock. The original C calls and receipt policies are preserved. Only Check and process-handle Update select a resident stream route.
retained_failures: A selected-but-missing resident store fails even if the issuer reservation is valid. A wait local-event close does not revoke the separate remote receipt. A receipt alias in a reservation cannot close the request store's corresponding receipt.
